eval_dimensions.name: Phase 0 Spec-Compliance BLOCKED Escalation
eval_dimensions.description: When the spec-reviewer subagent returns BLOCKED (FAIL_SCOPE / FAIL_MISSING / FAIL_OVER), the skill fires AskUserQuestion (Address spec gap first / Continue review anyway) before running Step 2+ — it never silently continues review on a failed spec check.

eval_dimensions.name: Zero-Findings Confirmation Gate (GH-447 F5)
eval_dimensions.description: In attended mode, even when zero findings are produced, the skill fires AskUserQuestion to confirm the clean review rather than silently skipping through. The gate is exempted only when invoked with --unattended (GH-760 F6).

eval_dimensions.name: Findings-Present Disposition Gate
eval_dimensions.description: When findings > 0 in attended mode, the skill fires AskUserQuestion (Fix all / Pick findings / Skip) before invoking dev10x:review-fix — findings are never auto-fixed without user disposition in attended mode.

eval_dimensions.name: Unattended Confidence-Threshold Filtering
eval_dimensions.description: In unattended mode, only findings with confidence >= threshold (default 70) AND severity ERROR/WARNING are passed to dev10x:review-fix; below-threshold findings are logged as INFO, not silently dropped or auto-fixed.

eval_dimensions.name: One Parallel Subagent per Routed Reviewer Spec (GH-1741)
eval_dimensions.description: Step 4 routes changed files through .claude/rules/INDEX.md and dispatches one subagent per matched reviewer spec, all in a single message, with each subagent's files inlined. The orchestrator merges the reports; it does not apply reviewer specs inline itself.

eval_dimensions.name: Phase 0 Failure Short-Circuits the Fan-Out (GH-1741)
eval_dimensions.description: When spec-reviewer returns BLOCKED, no domain reviewer subagent is dispatched before the gate resolves, and none at all when the user picks 'Address spec gap first'.

eval_dimensions.name: Findings JSON Contract Unchanged (GH-1741)
eval_dimensions.description: Merged subagent findings are written in the existing handoff format (severity ERROR/WARNING/INFO, confidence, source, file, line, description, suggested_fix, category) with no added keys, so dev10x:review-fix consumes them unchanged.

eval_dimensions.name: Every Loop Round Uses Fresh Reviewers (GH-1831)
eval_dimensions.description: With --loop, each round issues new Agent calls; no round continues an earlier reviewer via SendMessage, and the orchestrator never declares its own fix correct in place of a reviewer round.

eval_dimensions.name: Rounds 2+ Review Only the Delta and Its Blast Radius (GH-1831)
eval_dimensions.description: From round 2 on, the reviewed scope is git diff <round_start_sha>..HEAD plus the files referencing symbols that delta changed; files outside it are not re-dispatched.

eval_dimensions.name: Only Defects Keep the Loop Going (GH-1831)
eval_dimensions.description: Findings are classified as defects or polish in the round ledger (not in the findings JSON); a round with zero defects ends the loop as clean even when polish remains, and from round 2 on only defects are sent to dev10x:review-fix.

eval_dimensions.name: Hard Stop After Round 4 Escalates (GH-1831)
eval_dimensions.description: When round 4 still yields defects, round 5 never starts on its own: attended mode fires AskUserQuestion with the ledger-derived option first; --unattended resolves shipping_continuation and, on auto-advance, stops with a BLOCKED: review-loop status line, never auto-continuing or auto-shipping.

eval_dimensions.name: Only a Clean Pass Writes the Review Stamp (GH-1830)
eval_dimensions.description: A pass that handed nothing to dev10x:review-fix — a single pass with no ERROR/WARNING finding at confidence >= 70, or a loop round with an empty fix set — calls review_stamp_write; a pass that handed findings to the fixer, skipped findings, or a loop ending on Ship, Stop or a BLOCKED: review-loop line never does.

evals.name: spec-reviewer BLOCKED verdict fires the escalation gate
evals.description: When the Phase 0 spec-reviewer subagent's trailing status line is BLOCKED, the skill must stop and ask before running automated checks or per-file review.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with 'Address spec gap first (Recommended)' / 'Continue review anyway' options
No inline 'spec looks off, should I continue?' text substitutes for the widget
Step 3 (automated checks) does NOT run before the gate resolves

evals.name: DONE_WITH_CONCERNS continues without a gate but queues the concern
evals.description: A PARTIAL spec verdict continues to Step 2 directly (no AskUserQuestion) but records the concern as a WARNING finding with source=manual and category=spec in the final summary.

assertions.signal: No AskUserQuestion fires for DONE_WITH_CONCERNS; review proceeds to Step 2 and the concern appears as a WARNING finding with source=manual and category=spec in the final summary; no finding carries source=spec, which dev10x:review-fix does not accept (GH-1749)

evals.name: --unattended BLOCKED verdict resolves the gate instead of stalling
evals.description: Under --unattended, a BLOCKED spec verdict calls resolve_gate(gate=shipping_continuation); on auto-advance it takes 'Address spec gap first' without a widget, skips Steps 2-6, reports an ERROR spec finding (source=manual, category=spec) in the Step 7 summary rather than the findings handoff file, and ends with a BLOCKED: spec status line (GH-1749).
evals.input: /dev10x:review --unattended (spec-reviewer returns BLOCKED: FAIL_MISSING; resolve_gate returns auto-advance)

assertions.signal: resolve_gate is called with gate=shipping_continuation before any AskUserQuestion
AskUserQuestion is NOT called on auto-advance; 'Continue review anyway' is never auto-selected
No Step 3 check or Step 4 subagent runs; the final line starts with 'BLOCKED: spec:'

evals.name: Zero findings still fires AskUserQuestion in attended mode
evals.description: A clean review (0 findings) in attended (default) mode must still confirm via AskUserQuestion — it does not silently report done.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with 'Continue (Recommended)' / 'Re-review' options even though findings=0
No inline 'looks clean, want to continue?' text substitutes for the widget

evals.name: --unattended exempts the zero-findings gate
evals.description: When invoked with --unattended (e.g. from work-on's shipping pipeline), a clean review auto-advances without firing AskUserQuestion (GH-760 F6).

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is NOT called when --unattended is set, even at 0 findings; the skill auto-advances

evals.name: Findings > 0 in attended mode fires the disposition gate
evals.description: When the review produces at least one finding in attended mode, AskUserQuestion fires with Fix all / Pick findings / Skip before dev10x:review-fix is invoked.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with 'Fix all (Recommended)' / 'Pick findings' / 'Skip' options
No inline 'want me to fix these findings?' text substitutes for the widget
Skill(dev10x:review-fix) is NOT invoked before the gate resolves

evals.name: Unattended mode filters findings by confidence before fixing
evals.description: In unattended mode, only findings with confidence >= 70 (default) and severity ERROR/WARNING reach dev10x:review-fix; below-threshold findings are logged as INFO.

assertions.signal: Only the two confidence>=70 findings are passed to dev10x:review-fix; the confidence=40 finding appears as INFO in the summary, not sent to the fixer

evals.name: Routed reviewer specs are dispatched in parallel
evals.description: A branch touching a Python module, a skill and a doc reaches several reviewer specs via INDEX.md; each gets its own subagent, all issued in one message.

assertions.signal: Agent is called once per routed spec (reviewer-generic, reviewer-security, reviewer-silent-failures, reviewer-skill, reviewer-skill-behavior, reviewer-docs), and every one of those calls is in the same assistant message
Each domain Agent prompt carries its files as inlined <file> blocks (diff + content) and the verbatim coverage-first instruction; no Agent call passes a model override
The orchestrator does not Read .claude/agents/reviewer-*.md specs and apply their checklists itself in place of dispatch

evals.name: A failed spec gate dispatches no domain reviewer
evals.description: spec-reviewer returns BLOCKED: FAIL_SCOPE and the user picks 'Address spec gap first'; the domain fan-out never runs.
evals.input: /dev10x:review (spec-reviewer returns BLOCKED: FAIL_SCOPE; user picks Address spec gap first)

assertions.signal: The only Agent call in the session is the spec-reviewer dispatch; no reviewer-* subagent is dispatched
AskUserQuestion fires before any domain dispatch could happen

evals.name: Merged subagent findings keep the review-fix handoff shape
evals.description: Two subagents flag the same file:line, one as CRITICAL; the merged findings file has one entry for that line with severity ERROR and the existing keys only.
evals.input: /dev10x:review --unattended (reviewer-generic WARNING and reviewer-security CRITICAL on src/dev10x/foo.py:12)

assertions.signal: The findings JSON has exactly one entry for src/dev10x/foo.py:12, with severity ERROR
Every entry carries only severity, confidence, source, file, line, description, suggested_fix and category, and Skill(dev10x:review-fix) receives that file path

evals.name: A repo without INDEX.md routes by the plugin reviewers' Triggers
evals.description: In a consumer repo with no .claude/rules/INDEX.md and no .claude/agents/, a changed migration still reaches its domain reviewer through the plugin-distributed spec.
evals.input: /dev10x:review --unattended (consumer repo, no .claude/rules/INDEX.md or .claude/agents/; changes: app/migrations/0042_add_index.py, app/views.py)

assertions.signal: Agent is called with subagent_type dev10x:reviewer-migration for app/migrations/0042_add_index.py, matched by that spec's Triggers: pattern
app/views.py, which matches no plugin reviewer's Triggers, is reviewed by the orchestrator against references/review-checks-common.md, and the summary says so

evals.name: Round 2 re-reviews the fixups with new agents on the delta only
evals.description: Round 1 finds a bug in src/dev10x/foo.py; review-fix commits a fixup touching foo.py. Round 2 dispatches new Agent calls covering foo.py and the files referencing the changed function, and nothing else.
evals.input: /dev10x:review --unattended --loop (round 1: 1 defect in src/dev10x/foo.py; fixup changes parse_args(); src/dev10x/cli.py calls parse_args)

assertions.signal: Round 2 issues new Agent calls; SendMessage is never used to re-engage a round-1 reviewer
Round 2 Agent prompts inline only src/dev10x/foo.py and src/dev10x/cli.py; untouched branch files from round 1 are not re-dispatched
The loop does not end on the orchestrator's own judgment that the fix is correct; it ends only on a reviewer round with zero defects

evals.name: A round with only polish findings ends the loop
evals.description: Round 2 returns two style WARNINGs (confidence 80) and no defect; the loop ends clean without a round 3 and the polish appears in the summary.

assertions.signal: No round 3 starts and dev10x:review-fix is not invoked for the round-2 polish; the summary lists both polish findings and reports the loop ended clean
The findings JSON carries no defect/polish key; the classification lives only in the round ledger
review_stamp_write is called once after the clean round 2

evals.name: Skipping defects in attended mode writes no stamp
evals.description: An attended pass finds 2 ERROR findings and the user picks Skip, or Pick findings with none approved; nothing reaches the fixer, but the pass is not clean.
evals.input: /dev10x:review (attended mode, 2 ERROR findings, user picks Skip or approves none under Pick findings)

assertions.signal: mcp__plugin_dev10x_cli__review_stamp_write is never called; the summary lists both findings as open

evals.name: Round-1 polish fixes get a second round
evals.description: Round 1 of a loop finds only 2 style WARNINGs (confidence 80) and no defect; they go to the fixer, so round 1 is not clean and round 2 reviews the fixups.

assertions.signal: Skill(dev10x:review-fix) runs in round 1, round 2 dispatches new Agent calls on the fixup delta, and review_stamp_write is called only after round 2

evals.name: Round 4 with open defects fires the escalation gate
evals.description: Attended loop with defect counts 5, 3, 2, 1 across rounds 1-4; round 5 does not start until the supervisor answers.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with 'Continue one more round (Recommended)' first, because the count fell every round, plus 'Ship with open defects listed' and 'Stop and hand back'
No inline 'still finding issues, keep going?' text substitutes for the widget
No round-5 Agent call is issued and Skill(dev10x:review-fix) is not invoked for round 4 before the gate resolves

evals.name: A fixer that commits nothing ends the loop
evals.description: Unattended loop round 2 hands 1 defect to dev10x:review-fix, which makes no commit; with no delta there is nothing to re-review.

assertions.signal: No round 3 starts; the summary runs and the final line starts with 'BLOCKED: review-loop:' and names the fixer making no commit
mcp__plugin_dev10x_cli__review_stamp_write is never called

evals.name: An attended Skip inside the loop ends it unstamped
evals.description: Attended loop round 2 has 1 defect; the user picks Skip at the Step 6 findings gate.

assertions.signal: Skill(dev10x:review-fix) is not invoked for round 2, no round 3 starts, and the summary lists the skipped defect as open
mcp__plugin_dev10x_cli__review_stamp_write is never called

evals.name: A finding left unpicked keeps a later clean round from stamping
evals.description: Attended loop round 1 has 2 defects; the user picks one under Pick findings. Round 2 reviews that fix and is clean, but its delta never reaches the declined defect.

assertions.signal: The ledger's declined list names the unpicked defect, and the summary lists it as open
mcp__plugin_dev10x_cli__review_stamp_write is never called, although round 2 is clean

evals.name: A finding the fixer deferred keeps a later clean round from stamping
evals.description: Unattended loop round 1 has 2 defects; the fixer commits one and reports the other as deferred. Round 2 reviews that commit and is clean, but its delta never reaches the deferred defect.

assertions.signal: The ledger's declined list names the deferred defect, and the summary lists it as open
mcp__plugin_dev10x_cli__review_stamp_write is never called, although round 2 is clean

evals.name: An attended clean round confirms through the zero-findings gate
evals.description: Attended loop round 2 is clean but lists 1 INFO finding and 1 polish finding; the user answers Re-review, and the repeat is clean too.
evals.input: /dev10x:review --loop (round 2: clean, 1 INFO, 1 polish; user picks Re-review, then Continue)

assertions.signal: The Continue / Re-review gate fires and names the INFO and polish findings; the Fix all / Pick findings / Skip gate does not fire
Re-review dispatches new Agent calls on round 2's scope and adds no ledger entry

evals.name: A churning loop recommends stopping
evals.description: Defect counts 3, 2, 2, 3 across rounds 1-4 are not falling; the gate leads with Stop and hand back.

assertions.signal: The first option is 'Stop and hand back (Recommended)'; exactly one option carries (Recommended)

evals.name: --unattended at the cap stops instead of continuing
evals.description: Unattended loop reaches round 4 with open defects and resolve_gate(shipping_continuation) returns auto-advance.

assertions.signal: resolve_gate is called with gate=shipping_continuation
No AskUserQuestion and no round 5; the summary runs and the final line starts with 'BLOCKED: review-loop:'
mcp__plugin_dev10x_cli__review_stamp_write is never called

evals.name: A clean loop round stamps the reviewed head
evals.description: Round 2 of an unattended loop finds no defects; the skill stamps the head before the summary and reports its SHA.

assertions.signal: review_stamp_write is called once, after round 2 and with an absolute cwd; the summary names the returned head_sha

evals.name: A single pass that sent findings to the fixer is not clean
evals.description: Without --loop, a pass hands 2 defects to dev10x:review-fix; the resulting fixups are unreviewed, so no stamp is written.

assertions.signal: Skill(dev10x:review-fix) runs and mcp__plugin_dev10x_cli__review_stamp_write is never called

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the review skill

should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation — attended self-review of the current branch

should_trigger.query: review my changes before I open a PR
should_trigger.rationale: Pre-PR self-review — the core use case

should_not_trigger.query: my branch has no commits yet
should_not_trigger.rationale: Nothing to review — no diff exists against base
